title: Q-RULEREFS-pilot-consumer: pilot applications are stored and no loop reads them
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** rulerefs audit 2026-11-25 (RULE-REFS-1, CLOSED-LOOP-1): an inflow with no consumer
**Done check:** grep:dashboard/worker.js::pilot:
**Status:** open

code-task: repo=ultrastable/ultrastable path=dashboard/worker.js
POST /api/pilot scores an application and writes it to KV under `pilot:<time>:<id>` (site/worker.js pilotApplication). Nothing in site/, dashboard/, seed/worker/src or foundation/ lists that prefix, so an application is never seen. Q-CLAIM-reply-promise recorded this on 2026-11-20 and was shelved while /pilot, /contact and the API went on promising a reply from a person within two working days; on 2026-11-25 the four sentences were changed to what the code does (scored and stored; email the pilot team) and claim `reply-promise` was registered. Close the loop: the owner console lists `pilot:` keys with fit and age, the tick mails the owner a new fit through the existing mail path, and a probe fails when a fit application is older than the window with no recorded answer.

size: S

**Closing probe:** the owner console reads the `pilot:` prefix and a test covers the listing.
